confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live menus or listings were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderate confidence, while hotel rates are less certain because of tourist pricing and July seasonality. Bar prices use the local price relationship to beer (cocktail about 2x and wine glass about 1.5x the domestic draft beer) because direct knowledge is weak. USD levels depend on the volatile Egyptian pound, and hostel registration status is unverified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is Northern Africa. Marrakech is the closest North African tourist comparable; Cairo is judged somewhat or much cheaper than Marrakech in most categories and close to it for cafes and dorm beds. Mumbai serves as a low-cost reference and Cape Town as an upper African bound.
